verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an app with a synced, self-hostable backend, so registrable outbound event callbacks are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no webhook capability. The CLI export tooling, enteauth:// search deep links and scriptable exports are adjacent features, not outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can subscribe to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
